name: flipcountdown

frames.best_why: All four tiles show clear digits, with the orange day tile glowing and the seconds reading 41.

tagline: Four glowing number tiles ticking down the seconds to the new year.
summary: A black page with a small spaced caption over four square number tiles: a glowing orange days box and three navy boxes for hours, minutes and seconds. The seconds tick down live and the layout ends in a Time's Up message.
appearance: A wide black stage with a small widely tracked NEW YEAR COUNTDOWN label. Below sit four rounded square tiles split by a thin line, the first filled orange-red with white digits, the rest dark navy with cyan digits and blue glowing rims. Small grey dots separate the tiles and tiny blue unit labels sit beneath each.
behaviour: The seconds tile changes every second while days, hours and minutes hold steady. When the clock reaches zero the tiles are replaced by a red Time's Up banner.
demo_content: Caption "NEW YEAR COUNTDOWN" showing 51 days, 04 hours, 14 minutes and a seconds tile ticking toward zero.
search_phrases: new year countdown for a landing page
use_when: A launch or event page needs a live countdown with a bold arcade-like numeric display.
avoid_when: The target is always the current year's end, and the orange and cyan glow and black page are fixed.
customise: The target date is computed as the end of the current year and the label is fixed; tile colours, sizes and the flip class need source edits.
weight_why: One interval updating four numbers each second; no canvas or heavy work.

a11y.note: The numbers are plain spans with no live region, so screen readers never hear the ticking; the flip class has no reduced-motion guard.

issues: The colon separators render as two small stacked blocks rather than a colon.
Digits update silently with no live region for assistive tech.
polish_why: Neat neon tiles with a good glow, but the separators look like stray stacked dots.
title: Flip Countdown Timer
